title.english: The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World
title.native: 捨てられ聖女の異世界ごはん旅 隠れスキルでキャンピングカーを召喚しました

synonyms: สตรีศักดิ์สิทธิ์ผู้ถูกทอดทิ้ง ออกเดินทางชิมอาหารในต่างโลกด้วยสกิลลับอัญเชิญรถบ้านแคมป์ปิ้ง
Isekai CamPer - I viaggi culinari in un altro mondo della santa rinnegata: Ho evocato un camper grazie a una skill nascosta

node.description: She was summoned to another world, only to get kicked out in a split second. Her hobbies are solo camping, cooking, and TRPGs, but now she's living the ultimate *real-life* RPG dream! The chance to hunt, cook, and eat her own food? It’s absolutely the best! She'll be doing her best as the cook and pack-mule for the adventurer party "Gluttony’s Table"! Oh, and apparently, she is a Saint or something.

She’s a beauty and a member of the "Gluttony Table." Watching her fight using threads is so cool—it practically brings back memories of [Rin's](https://anilist.co/character/394148/Rin-Takanashi) sealed-away "chuunibyou" phase! Plus, she smells amazing and is so soft; getting a tight hug from her makes Rin go "hehehe"... She’s totally best-girl material! It’s also wonderful how head-over-heels in love she is with her husband, [Edo](https://anilist.co/character/398642/Edo). Oh, and she absolutely loves eating delicious food.

He’s the first "Ogre-Dragon" guy [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/394148/Rin-Takanashi) met in this other world. He’s a highly skilled adventurer and the leader of the "Gluttony Table." Sure, he’s got a bit of a high "fuel consumption" and looks intimidating, but he’s a gentleman—kind, strong, and handsome to boot! He’s a total feast for the eyes. He’s definitely a favorite of Rin! Oh, and he loves eating delicious food.

He’s a magic alchemist and a member of the "Gluttony Table." He’s cheerful and personable, but he absolutely dotes on his wife, [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/398641/Aria); whenever Aria and [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/394148/Rin-Takanashi) give each other a tight hug, he shoots her a really intense look... It’s just friendship—pure friendship! Still, seeing how head-over-heels they are for each other is just the best. Oh, and he loves eating delicious food.

A winged cat we encountered in a certain dungeon. Apparently, it’s the offspring of a monster known as a... well, whatever it is. But such details don't matter when faced with that fluffiness! It acts a bit haughty, but it’s actually a total cuddle-bug that loves anyone who dotes on it.

She is the female Kobold receptionist at the Adventurers' Guild in the city of Elrage—the home base of the "Gluttony Party." Fluffiness, round two! Yet, despite appearances, she is a seasoned veteran with twenty years of service under her belt; a reliable, attentive, and caring adult woman.

An elf and a member of the "Gluttony Table." He’s a cleric who uses healing and support magic, though he’s also been known to bash monsters with a mace instead of a bow. There’s a unique kind of nourishment to be found in an elf whose appearance is deceptive—possessing mystical beauty and a fragile air, yet overflowing with raw power! He’s a character you just have to root for. Plus, he loves eating delicious food.

The Adventurer's Guild Master—a burly, rugged guy who looks the part with his muscular build, eyepatch, and the cross-shaped scar on his face. While his words and actions are as boisterous as his appearance suggests, he also possesses a cool head and a thoughtful nature; he’s exactly the kind of person you’d want as a boss. That said, it seems like he can't say no to [Sheila-san](https://anilist.co/character/400913/Sheila), doesn't it?
